issues.finding: The durable task spec starts with a Markdown heading and has no NDS frontmatter. It cannot satisfy repository C1 documentation compliance when promoted.
issues.required_fix: Add schema-valid repository-standard frontmatter with correct task identity, version, status and change_log before promotion; rebind the reviewed spec hash.

issues.finding: spec_ref is an absolute temporary-directory path. Promoted contract and fresh CI would depend on a workstation-owned temporary file rather than the declared durable repository spec.
issues.required_fix: Set spec_ref to .agent/product_spec_post_ga_nip_planning.md; retain temporary review provenance separately if desired.

issues.finding: AT2 requires a staged decision/acceptance matrix but does not define independently testable row/column obligations or responsible owners and verdict-to-transition outcomes. AT5 has no malformed-WA control. A topic-marker or empty-matrix check could pass without the requested concrete Workflow Assurance design.
issues.required_fix: Specify the minimum structural matrix coverage and fields, including accountable owner, obligation/input/check/evidence, blocking outcome and allowed transition, plus explicit unresolved decision choices/gate dependencies. Require at least one positive control and discriminating malformed-WA controls (e.g. missing owner, empty acceptance row or pass permitting acceptance without H-NIP). These may be implemented in the new Evaluator-owned checker after both gates.

missing_acceptance_coverage: Concrete WA row/owner/transition semantics and negative discrimination are not defined by the proposed verification contract.
